headline: Madison Reed Appoints Consumer Investor and Brand-Builder Jay Sammons to Its Board of Directors
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 30, 2026--Madison Reed, the prestige beauty brand revolutionizing the hair color industry, today announced the appointment of Jay Sammons to its Board of Directors. A veteran consumer investor and brand-builder, Sammons brings more than 20 years of experience partnering with founders to help build category-defining consumer brands.
